sections.title: Host–Pathogen Interactions: Immunity, Evasion, and Disease
sections.description: This graduate-level seminar explores the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying host–pathogen interactions, focusing on immune recognition, pathogen immune evasion, inflammation, and disease progression. Through critical analysis of primary research literature, students will examine host defense mechanisms, pathogen survival strategies, and emerging technologies for studying infection and immunity. Discussions will connect fundamental biological mechanisms to therapeutic development, biotechnology, and immune-mediated disease.
